description: The four label-disciplined satellite webviews — dock (dictation pill), agent-partials (live transcription HUD), point-overlay (Symon pointer), spatial-ink (draw-on-screen ink). They were four separate capability files carrying BYTE-IDENTICAL permission sets and differing only in which window label they targeted; they are one capability with four windows now. Each window holds exactly the grants it held before — this is a merge, not a widening. WHY THEY NEED A CAPABILITY AT ALL: each renders a REMOTE-URL webview (the bundled-Next origin), and Tauri injects no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ into a remote-URL webview unless some capability's `remote.urls` matches that origin AND its `windows` includes the label. Without it isTauri() is false, listen()/emit() never attach, and the surface is inert — the dock paints its idle capsule but can never morph, the HUD stays blank, the pointer never paints, the operator can never draw. LABEL-DISCIPLINED: events only. NO window-control / updater / process / shell permissions — those stay main-only, enforced in dock_window.rs, agent_partials_window.rs, point_overlay.rs and spatial_ink_window.rs. WHY IT IS ONE FILE: every `remote.urls` entry is compiled into a urlpattern -> regex -> DFA at startup, inside generate_context!(), on the main thread. Four identical copies meant four times the compilation for zero additional grant. See the Speed PR.
